lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Directions

ask for and give directions, describe where places are relative to each other, and say how far away something is.

  1. 往 + direction + verb: 往前走，往左拐。
  2. A 离 B + 远 / 近: 学校离我家很近。 With a distance: 离这儿五百米。 (Not 从, which marks a starting point.)
  3. 一直 + verb = keep doing it: 一直往前走。
  4. Place + 在 + reference + location word: 商店在医院旁边 / 对面。 我在他们中间。
  5. 过 + road or intersection = cross it: 过了马路往左拐。
  6. …怎么走？ asks for walking directions: 请问，地铁站怎么走？

Practice activities

  • Role-play: A lost tourist (the app) asks you the way to three places on a map the app shows. Give full directions, then ask a follow-up: 听懂了吗？
  • Blindfold navigator: The app gives spoken commands (往前走三步，往左拐……); follow them around your room, then reverse them aloud.
  • Compass map: Handwrite a map of your neighborhood with 东南西北 and 6 places; describe it with 旁边, 对面, 中间.
  • Odd one out: 左边 / 右边 / 旁边 / 马路 (马路 isn't a position) · 东 / 南 / 北 / 楼 · 往 / 离 / 拐 / 米 (米 is a noun)
  • Character detective: 边, 过, 近 all carry 辶 (movement); 拐 carries 扌 (hand: you signal with your hand).
  • Story chain starter: 我家在……。从我家一直往……走……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Comparisons

compare people and things with 比, say how big the difference is, and say when two things are equal or not as good.

  1. A 比 B + adjective: 他比我高。 Never 很 after 比: 他比我很高 is wrong.
  2. How much more goes after the adjective: 他比我高一点儿。她比我大三岁。今天比昨天热得多。
  3. 更 = even more: 今天比昨天更冷。 (更 can appear after 比 B; 很 can't.)
  4. A 没有 B (那么) + adjective = A is not as … as B: 我没有他那么高。
  5. A 跟 B 一样 (+ adjective): 我跟他一样高。
  6. 差不多 = about the same: 我们差不多大。

Practice activities

  • Role-play: choosing a phone. You and a friend (the app) compare two phones on price, size and weight. Use 比, 更, 没有…那么 and 一样, then decide which to buy.
  • Comparison chain: The app shows three people with ages, heights and weights; make 6 different comparisons in 60 seconds.
  • Opposites match: Drag pairs together: 高–矮, 长–短, 胖–瘦, 重–轻, 难–容易, 老–年轻.
  • City vs city: Compare your city with Beijing on weather, size and food, in writing.
  • Odd one out: 高 / 矮 / 胖 / 比 (比 isn't an adjective) · 更 / 比 / 跟 / 漂亮 · 长 / 短 / 难 / 米
  • Character detective: 矮 and 短 share 矢 (arrow, a measuring stick); 胖 carries flesh 月; 瘦 carries sickness 疒.
  • Story chain starter: 我有一个朋友，他比我……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Experiences

say what you have and haven't done before with 过, how many times, and talk about places you've been.

  1. Verb + 过 = have done it before: 我去过北京。
  2. Negate with 没, never 不: 我没去过上海。
  3. Questions: 你吃过饺子吗？ or 你吃过饺子没有？
  4. Number + 次 goes after the verb: 我去过两次北京。 / 我去过北京两次。 With a person, 次 goes last: 我见过他两次。
  5. 从来没…过 = never ever: 我从来没见过熊猫。
  6. 第一次 + verb: 这是我第一次来中国。

Words from earlier units

过guo(have done before)

Practice activities

  • Role-play: "Have you ever…?" The app fires 10 你……过……吗？ questions; answer each with 过 or 没…过, adding how many times or when.
  • Two truths and a lie: Write three 过 sentences about yourself, one false; the app (or a friend) guesses which.
  • Bucket list: Handwrite 5 things you've done (with 次) and 5 you've never done (从来没…过).
  • Travel photos: Describe 3 of your photos aloud: 这是……，我去过……次。
  • Odd one out: 北京 / 上海 / 长城 / 熊猫 (熊猫 isn't a place) · 次 / 过 / 从来 / 城市 · 爬山 / 见面 / 旅游 / 照片 (照片 isn't an activity)
  • Story chain starter: 去年我第一次……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Finished actions

say what you did, didn't do, and haven't done yet, with 了, 没, 还没…呢, 完 and 刚.

  1. 了 for a completed action. With a plain object, put 了 at the end: 我吃饭了。 With a number or detail on the object, put it after the verb: 我吃了两个饺子。
  2. Negate with 没 and drop 了: 我没吃饭。 (Never 没吃了.)
  3. 还没…呢 = not yet: 我还没吃饭呢。
  4. Verb + 完 = finish doing it: 我做完作业了。
  5. 刚 + verb (just did) vs 刚才 (a moment ago, a time word): 我刚到。 刚才他来了。
  6. Questions: …了吗？ or …了没有？

Practice activities

  • Role-play: chores check. The app plays a parent asking 你……了吗？ about 6 chores; answer with ……了 or 还没……呢, then promise when you'll do the rest.
  • Yesterday log: Handwrite 6 things you did yesterday with 了, and 2 you didn't do with 没.
  • Done / not yet sort: The app shows a to-do list with some ticked; drag each into 已经…了 or 还没…呢 and say the sentence.
  • Lost and found: Describe something you lost and found: 我的……丢了。……我找到了。
  • Odd one out: 开始 / 结束 / 完 / 礼物 · 钥匙 / 门 / 礼物 / 刚 (刚 isn't a thing) · 丢 / 找到 / 收到 / 作业 (作业 isn't a verb)
  • Story chain starter: 今天早上我的钥匙丢了。……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Plans and the near future

talk about plans with 打算 and 计划, say something is about to happen with 快要…了 / 就要…了, and make predictions with 会.

  1. 打算 + verb: 我打算明年去中国。 Time words go before or after the subject, never at the end.
  2. 快要…了 / 快…了 = about to: 我们快要出发了。 The 了 is required.
  3. With a specific time, use 就要…了, not 快要: 明天就要考试了。
  4. 会 = will (prediction): 明天会下雨。 Negative: 不会。
  5. Strength of intention: 想 (would like) < 打算 (plan) < 要 (will, firmly).

Practice activities

  • Role-play: travel agent. The app is a travel agent asking where you're going, when, for how long, and which hotel you want. Book the whole trip in Chinese.
  • My next year: Handwrite 6 sentences about next year with 打算, 计划, 想 and 要, ranked from least to most certain.
  • Countdown: The app names an upcoming event with or without a specific time; say it with 快要…了 or 就要…了 correctly.
  • Weather oracle: Predict tomorrow's weather in 3 cities with 会 / 不会, then check tomorrow.
  • Odd one out: 机票 / 护照 / 行李 / 毕业 (毕业 isn't a travel item) · 明年 / 后天 / 下个月 / 搬家 · 打算 / 计划 / 会 / 酒店

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

How long

say how long you did something, how long you've been doing it, and how long it's been since you did it.

  1. Duration goes after the verb: 我等了一个小时。他在北京住了三年。
  2. With an object, either repeat the verb or put the duration before the object: 我学汉语学了两年。 = 我学了两年汉语。
  3. 了…了 = and still going: 我学了两年汉语了。 (I've been learning for two years and still am.)
  4. Ask with 多长时间 or 多久: 你学了多长时间汉语？
  5. How long since you did something: duration + 没 + verb + 了: 我两天没睡觉了。
  6. 一会儿 after a verb = for a little while: 等一会儿，休息一会儿。

Practice activities

  • Role-play: job interview. The app is an interviewer at a 公司 asking how long you've studied, worked and lived in different places. Answer with exact durations.
  • Timer challenge: Start the app's timer, do a task (read, write 10 characters), then report the time in a full sentence: 我写了三分钟。
  • Life survey: Ask 5 people (or app characters) how long they sleep, commute and exercise; record and report the answers.
  • Haven't-in-ages: Write 5 sentences about things you haven't done in a long time: 我三年没……了。
  • Odd one out: 分钟 / 小时 / 一刻 / 公司 · 跑步 / 聊天 / 上网 / 半天 (半天 isn't an activity) · 排队 / 迟到 / 开会 / 周

tell 会, 能 and 可以 apart, ask permission, refuse politely, and ask for help.

  1. 会 = a skill you learned: 我会弹钢琴。
  2. 能 = able in this situation, or capable of an amount: 我今天不能来。他能吃五碗饭。
  3. 可以 = permission: 这儿可以拍照吗？
  4. Refusing: answer 可以…吗？ with 可以 / 当然可以 / 不行. For rules, use 不能: 这儿不能抽烟。
  5. 帮 + person + verb: 你能帮我修一下吗？ 帮忙 takes no object: 帮我一个忙 or 帮个忙, never 帮忙我.
  6. Verb + 一下 softens requests: 用一下，借一下。

Practice activities

  • Role-play: museum guard. Ask the guard (the app) permission for 5 things: photos, food, phone calls, sitting, going in. Then swap: you're the guard and must refuse politely twice.
  • Talent list: Handwrite 5 things you 会 do, 3 you 不会, and 2 you 能 do today but 不能 tomorrow.
  • Modal sorter: The app shows 10 sentences with a blank; drag 会, 能 or 可以 into each and explain the choice in one word (skill / able / allowed).
  • Sign reader: The app shows icons (no smoking, no parking, quiet zone); say the rule with 这儿不能…… or 这儿可以……
  • Odd one out: 会 / 能 / 可以 / 钢琴 · 抽烟 / 拍照 / 停车 / 图书馆 (图书馆 isn't an action) · 安静 / 大声 / 声音 / 借
  • Story chain starter: 我不会做饭，所以……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Clothes and colors

describe clothes and colors, tell 穿 from 戴, use clothing measure words, and describe people by what they wear.

  1. Descriptions with 的: 红色的衣服; 穿白衬衫的那个人 (the person wearing the white shirt). The description always comes before the noun.
  2. 穿 vs 戴: 穿 for anything your body goes into (衣服, 裤子, 鞋); 戴 for things you put on (眼镜, 帽子, 手表).
  3. Measure words: 一件衬衫, 一条裤子 / 裙子, 一双鞋.
  4. 的 can stand in for the noun: 我要红色的。 (I want the red one.)
  5. Shopping phrases: 有小一点儿的吗？可以换一件吗？很合适。

Practice activities

  • Role-play: clothing store. The app is a clerk. Ask for an item in a color and size, try it on, ask for a different size, and pay.
  • Guess who: The app shows a crowd of characters; describe one only by clothes and accessories (穿……的，戴……的) until the app guesses.
  • Outfit planner: Handwrite what you'll wear Monday to Friday, with colors and the right measure words.
  • Color dictation: The app reads 8 color words; color a grid in that order, then write each color's character.
  • Odd one out: 红 / 黄 / 蓝 / 鞋 (鞋 isn't a color) · 穿 / 戴 / 换 / 颜色 · 双 / 条 / 件 / 帽子
  • Character detective: 裤, 裙, 衬, 衫 carry 衤 (clothing, two dots); 红 and 绿 carry silk 纟 because colors came from dyed silk.
  • Story chain starter: 今天我穿了一件……

lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

Requests and favors

ask for things politely, say what someone told or let you do with 让 and 叫, and do things for someone with 给.

  1. 请 + person + verb: 请你帮我一下。
  2. 让 / 叫 + person + verb = make, let or tell someone do something: 妈妈让我早点儿回家。老师叫我们写作业。
  3. 给 + person + verb = do it for or to someone: 我给你打电话。你给我拿一杯水。
  4. 麻烦你 + verb (+ 好吗？) = would you mind: 麻烦你帮我开一下门，好吗？
  5. Politeness ladder: 开门！ → 请开门。 → 麻烦你开一下门，好吗？
  6. 打开 / 关上: verbs with a built-in result (opened, shut).

Practice activities

  • Role-play: hotel front desk. Ask the receptionist (the app) for 5 favors: turn on the AC, bring water, call a taxi, mail a parcel, wake you at 7. Use a different polite form each time.
  • Bossy robot: The app gives commands with 让 and 叫 (让机器人开灯。); repeat each as a direct request to the robot, then as a polite one.
  • Politeness ladder: Rewrite 5 blunt commands at three levels: ……！ / 请…… / 麻烦你……，好吗？
  • Who told whom? The app tells a short story; answer questions like 谁让谁做什么？
  • Odd one out: 灯 / 空调 / 窗户 / 让 (让 isn't a thing) · 打开 / 关上 / 拿 / 快递 · 请 / 让 / 叫 / 灯
  • Character detective: 空 and 窗 share 穴 (a cave, an opening); 灯 carries 火 (fire, the first lamps).
  • Story chain starter: 今天妈妈让我……

lessons.title: 语法 · Grammar
lessons.html:
语法 · Grammar

How well things are done

describe how well someone does something with 得, compare performance, and give and accept compliments. This unit closes HSK 2.

  1. Verb + 得 + (很) adjective: 他说得很流利。
  2. With an object, repeat the verb or move the object to the front: 他说汉语说得很好。 = 他汉语说得很好。 Never 他说汉语得很好.
  3. Negate the adjective, not the verb: 他说得不好。
  4. Ask with 怎么样 or adjective-not-adjective: 他唱得怎么样？他唱得好不好？
  5. Comparing with 得: 他跑得比我快。 = 他比我跑得快。
  6. Taking a compliment: 哪里哪里 / 还可以 / 谢谢. Modesty is the default.

Practice activities

  • Role-play: talent judge. The app performs (sings, reads a poem, tells a joke); judge each with a 得 sentence. Then read a paragraph aloud and let the app judge you; reply modestly.
  • Compliment volley: The app compliments 6 of your skills; answer each with 哪里哪里, 还可以 or 谢谢, plus one honest 得 sentence.
  • Self-assessment: Rate yourself on 说, 听, 写, 读, 唱 and 跑 with 得 (我写得很慢。), then compare with a friend using 比.
  • HSK 2 boss level: 30 questions drawn from all 10 HSK 2 units plus 10 from HSK 1, 3 lives; every miss returns to its unit's daily quiz.
  • Odd one out: 流利 / 清楚 / 标准 / 比赛 (比赛 isn't an adjective) · 发音 / 声调 / 句子 / 赢 · 厉害 / 棒 / 一般 / 表演
  • Story chain starter: 我的朋友唱歌唱得……
